item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-27
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. Notably, the `statcheck` and `escicheck` projects have made administrative updates and synchronized with external repositories, respectively, to enhance their functionality. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has improved its ontogenerator's code validation, and `docpluck` has addressed several issues, including text loss and rendering problems. The `coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in its model picker, and `regcheck` has fixed bugs related to its demo page, card preview, and ad blocker interference. These updates demonstrate the connections between our projects and the community's commitment to improving open-source research tools. Overall, it's an exciting time for our community, with many projects making strides towards better functionality and usability.

6 commits across 4 active repositories this week.
